video.title: Mountain Weather Update 10/23, Meteorologist Chris Tomer

description: Flash flooding and very high elevation mountain snow through tonight.  The freezing level drops quickly tonight.  Then a southern track low develops 10/24-10/25 NM/CO.  This is followed by a cold front across the Northern Rockies with snow accumulation 10/26-10/27.
